caption: Home, the default look: app icons on the screen like a phone, a dock at the bottom, time and battery at the top. Files, Photos, Documents by their familiar names.
Home (dark): the same, for evening sessions.
Studio Dark: dark grey, cool accents, panel on top. Easy on the eyes under studio lights.
Paper: light and warm, like the sketchbook.
Night Session: near-black; the panel hides until the mouse touches the bottom edge.
Big and Simple: large text and icons, a dock with the four things that matter.
Classic Desktop: taskbar at the bottom, menu on the left, familiar names and icons. Feels like the last computer.
Gruvbox: warm retro colors, panel on the left edge to keep the canvas wide.
The Super key, or the grid button on the dock: every app as an icon. Type a few letters to filter.
The menu (top-left button, or the Super key): every app by category, search box at the top.
Ask Flattoo: type what you need in plain words.
Ask Flattoo answering 'something like paint': the drawing apps that fit this laptop, Open or Install.
Looks: pick a whole-desktop preset or save the current one.
Layouts: open and arrange a set of windows in one click.
Lock This Setup: freezes the current desktop into the system. Unlock needs the administrator password.
Portfolio: what it will do before it does anything — originals untouched, location data stripped, nothing uploaded, only clients who agreed.
Artist Profile: the basics, skills, certifications, the résumé, the exposure checklist.
Print as Stencil with no stencil printer attached: it offers the other printers at true size instead. With the stencil printer on, it asks for width on skin, mirror, crisp lines or shading, copies.
Right-click an image in Files: Print as Stencil, Clean Lines, Open in Krita.
Reference + Draw: Krita on the left, the image viewer on the right for the reference.
Paperwork: Firefox on the left, Files on the right.
The i3 tiling session (pick it at the login screen): bar at the bottom, Super+D to launch, Super+Space for Ask Flattoo.
